definitions.gloss: large sum of money, large amount of money
definitions.explanation: A large amount specifically referring to money or financial value.

examples.japanese: {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{投|とう}じられた→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧。
examples.english: A large sum was invested in the research.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧だまし{取|と}られる⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相次|あいつ}いでいる→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧。
examples.english: Cases of large sums of cash being swindled by fraud groups are occurring one after another.

notes:
{多額|たがく} combines {多|た} (many, much) and ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount, sum). It is used exclusively for monetary amounts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧ (large debt)
- {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (large cost)
- {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧ (large donation)
- {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧ (large investment)
- {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧ (large financial damages)

USAGE:
Always used with the particle ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before the noun it modifies: {多額|たがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + money-related noun. Unlike ⟦{大金|たいきん}→大金：12192_taikin⟧ (large sum), {多額|たがく} is more formal and commonly seen in news and official writing.
